Transparency

About this site

Editorial approach

Cricket Match Updates is an independent sports-information page. Schedule facts are checked against organizer sources, and unconfirmed reports are not presented as official announcements.

Privacy

This page does not ask for an account, payment or personal information. Standard hosting and campaign measurement may process basic technical visit data.

Editorial policyPrivacy policyBack to top ↑

Editorial policy

Cricket Match Updates is an independent sports-information page. Our purpose is to help readers find schedules, team context and player stories.

Sources and accuracy

Fixture details are checked against official organizer sources such as BCCI and ICC. If a schedule changes, the organizer's official page is the final reference.

Clear reporting

Confirmed announcements are kept separate from previews and opinion. We do not present unconfirmed information as official news.

Privacy policy

This page does not ask visitors to create an account, make a payment or submit personal information.

Technical information

Our hosting provider and advertising measurement link may process basic technical data such as device type, approximate location and visit time for security and campaign reporting.

External websites

Links to official cricket websites open independently and are governed by those websites' own privacy policies.
